messages:
morgan: hi all, stepping on shift now :wave:
morgan: I'm primary for the next 8h (starting now). Ashley is secondary but needs to step away 02:00-03:00 UTC (see below). Quick summary:
morgan: - Active incident: INC-384 (search latency spike in us-west). Mitigation so far: temporary rate-limiting rule applied to /v1/search, fallback to model variant small-search-v2. Latency back to ~350ms from 900ms for most traffic, but tails still high for some customers.
morgan: - Customer impact: a handful of paid customers experiencing degraded throughput and increased 429s earlier. CS alerted and we opened ticket RW-1129.
morgan: - Runbook pointer: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/search-latency
morgan: - Immediate ask: Ash, if you take over primary during your gap can we confirm who covers 02:00-03:00?
ashley: I can cover until 01:45 then need to step off for an hour. don't want to be primary while commuting.
sachin: heads-up: our scheduled infra maintenance window (db failover) at 02:15 — that'll overlap with ashley's gap. we should avoid leaving primary alone.
liam: I can take primary cover for 02:00-03:30 if needed. happy to be on-call overlap.
morgan: thanks liam, can you 1) confirm you can receive pages? 2) know the runbook steps for toggling the routing policy (we might need to roll traffic to eu-west)?
liam: yes, pages are enabled. quick steps I usually use:
liam: ```bash
# toggle routing to eu-west at the loadbalancer
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/routing -d '{\"route\":\"eu-west\",\"percent\":20}'
# reenable prefix KV cache
infra-cli cache enable --prefix search
```
liam: will also keep an eye on token rate limits for the paid tier
ashley: thx. I'll update the handoff doc and put a note in the schedule. Also adding RW-1130 to runbook: \"on-call gap coverage list\"
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Page sent to primary (morgan) for INC-384 at 1876543305. PagerDuty incident PD-789 created.
sachin: filing follow-up tickets:
sachin: - RW-1129 (customer communication) -> assigned to @cs-ops
sachin: - RW-1131 (investigate KV eviction pattern) -> assigned to @eng-runtime
morgan: I've created a short post-handoff checklist:
morgan: - transfer PD ownership to liam for 02:00-03:30 (PD note updated)
morgan: - create retro invite (30m) for tomorrow 11:00 UTC with eng/runtime, infra, cs
morgan: - add action item: evaluate automatic failover thresholds (owner: sachin)
morgan: - link trace logs to RW-1131
ashley: acked. I added a note in the shift calendar and flagged the maintenance overlap to infra.
liam: taking PD ownership for 02:00-03:30. I'll post status updates in this thread if anything changes.
morgan: thanks all. If anything spikes just @morgan or @liam and escalate to incident-bot with `incident escalate` command.
morgan: quick snippet to escalate if needed:
morgan: ```text
/incident escalate INC-384 priority=high notify=all
```
morgan: end of handoff — leaving detailed notes in the runbook page. :spiral_note_pad:
